title: Community tree planting — Harvington Wood, Manor Farm
body: Help the Heart of England Forest plant trees at Harvington Wood (Manor Farm, Anchor Lane, WR11 8PA), the former golf course it is turning into woodland. Two sessions, 9.30am to 12pm and 1pm to 3.30pm. Members of the team will be there to talk about their work and help you along the way. No experience necessary.
